meta.name: datadog-automation
meta.description: Automate Datadog tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): query metrics, search logs, manage monitors/dashboards, create events and downtimes. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 通过自然语言自动查询指标、管理监控和仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你日常需要频繁操作 Datadog 来监控系统状态
copy.tagline_en: Automate Datadog monitoring tasks via natural language
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently interact with Datadog for system monitoring

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 查询 Datadog 指标、搜索日志、管理监控器和仪表板、创建事件和停机维护。
howto.when: 当你要求查询 Datadog 数据、管理监控或仪表板，或需要创建事件/停机时触发。

say.text: 查询过去1小时web01的CPU使用率
say.note: Claude 会调用指标查询工具并返回数据。

say.text: 列出所有监控器并静音ID为123的监控器
say.note: Claude 会先列出监控器，再执行静音操作。

say.text: 创建一个名为“部署通知”的事件，类型为info
say.note: Claude 会调用创建事件工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query Datadog metrics, search logs, manage monitors and dashboards, create events and downtimes via Rube MCP.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to query Datadog data, manage monitors/dashboards, or create events/downtimes.

say_en.text: Query CPU usage for web01 in the last hour
say_en.note: Claude will call the metric query tool and return data.

say_en.text: List all monitors and mute monitor ID 123
say_en.note: Claude will list monitors then mute the specified one.

say_en.text: Create an event titled 'Deploy notification' with type info
say_en.note: Claude will call the create event tool.
